hooks.text: Jupiter's giant storm once swallowed three Earths side-by-side.
Jupiter's storm is shrinking, yet still swallows our planet.
Three Earths once fit inside Jupiter's red storm.

title: The Storm That Swallowed Three Earths
description: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is slowly shrinking after centuries of observation, but its massive 250-kilometer vortex can still engulf our entire world.

beats.text: It plunges 250 kilometers deep into Jupiter's dense atmosphere.

beats.text: Without a solid surface below, nothing creates friction to stop it.

beats.text: It survives by cannibalizing smaller passing storms like atmospheric prey.

beats.text: When those smaller storms thin out, this monster begins to starve.
